protocol.small_graphs: All simple graphs n=0..4, q=1..4, all terminal subsets of arity 0..3.
protocol.orders: Reverse vertex order and reverse terminal-subset order.
protocol.oracle: Complete named assignments and equality-pair encoding; no producer pattern generator.
protocol.book_family: K2 joined to k independent terminals, k=1..6, q=1..4; all internal and boundary colors.
protocol.gluing: 80 fixed-seed collections of zero to three pieces, each n=2..4, four palettes.
protocol.scope: Finite correctness audit; no timing, novelty or general coloring-theorem claim.
protocol.boundary_count: Distinct extendable named boundary assignments, not full coloring multiplicities.

three_port_counterexample.reason: Both adjacent internal vertices have only color 3 left.
